references.text: Basic command to eat unleavened bread for seven days starting from the fourteenth day of the first month, which is the original Passover ordinance
Command regarding the Feast of Unleavened Bread to be celebrated for seven days in the first month
Reiteration of the command to observe the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days in the month of Abib
The fifteenth day of the first month is the Lord's Feast of Unleavened Bread, and for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread
Command to eat unleavened bread for seven days during the Passover festival
The Israelites celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great joy under King Hezekiah
The Israelites celebrated Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days under King Josiah
The Jews celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with joy after returning from exile
Ezekiel's vision concerning the future celebration of Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month, with a seven-day festival of unleavened bread
